title: Q2 2026 Business Review
subtitle: Group performance, regional detail and the priorities we are asking the board to approve for Q3.
table_note: Revenue is recognised on shipment. Prior-year comparatives are restated for the 2025 France/Iberia territory split.
opening_note: Twenty minutes on the numbers, twenty on the regions, ten on the Q3 asks. Hold questions on headcount until the last slide.
scorecard_note: Every regional figure on this slide is summed from the same array the regional slides use, so the table and the detail cannot disagree.
closing_title: What we are asking for in Q3
closing_note: Three asks, one decision each. If we leave without the RH-9 allocation decision, the DACH forecast is not credible.
priorities: Secure RH-9 probe allocation for Q3 and Q4, or reforecast DACH down by roughly EUR 120,000.
Sign a second Benelux partner before the autumn tender round to cut concentration risk.
Fund one additional field engineer in Iberia from September.
Complete the French-language catalogue documentation by 30 September to hold the public-sector listing.
Move Nordic contract pricing to EUR from Q4 to stop currency noise reaching the regional numbers.

regions.name: DACH
highlights: Two multi-site framework agreements signed with utility groups in Bavaria and Lower Saxony.
MFS-220 logger backlog cleared: lead time down from 9 weeks to 4.
Telemetry renewals closed at 96 per cent of the eligible base.
regions.risk: Component allocation for the RH-9 probe is capped until October; Q3 upside above 5,000 units is not deliverable.
regions.notes: Strongest quarter on record. Push the room on whether the framework agreements are repeatable in Austria.
regions.question: Can we replicate the utility framework model outside Germany before year end?

regions.name: Benelux
highlights: Rotterdam distribution centre rollout completed two weeks early.
Partner channel now 38 per cent of regional revenue, up from 29 per cent.
First municipal water tender won in Flanders.
regions.risk: One partner accounts for 41 per cent of channel revenue; concentration risk is rising.
regions.notes: Solid, unspectacular. The story here is channel mix, not headline growth.
regions.question: Do we need a second partner in Flanders before the next tender round?

regions.name: Nordics
highlights: Online self-serve orders passed 1,000 units in a quarter for the first time.
Two Norwegian aquaculture accounts renewed for three years.
Field service response time improved to 3.1 hours against a 4-hour target.
regions.risk: Swedish krona weakness took roughly EUR 9,000 off reported revenue at constant currency.
regions.notes: Flat in EUR, up 7 per cent in local currency. Make the FX point explicitly.
regions.question: Should we quote Nordic contracts in EUR from Q4?

regions.name: UK & Ireland
highlights: Two of the three largest accounts renewed, both on longer terms.
Gold-tier support attach rate reached 44 per cent, the highest of any region.
Dublin service depot opened in June.
regions.risk: The single lost account was worth EUR 31,000 a quarter; the replacement pipeline covers about half of it.
regions.notes: The only region down year on year. Be straight about the lost account and the recovery plan.
regions.question: What is the realistic date for replacing the lost volume?

regions.name: France
highlights: Public-sector framework listing secured, opening 40 new buying entities.
Direct channel revenue up 11 per cent with no headcount added.
Average order value up from EUR 2,900 to EUR 3,350.
regions.risk: Framework listing requires French-language documentation for the full catalogue by 30 September.
regions.notes: Good operating leverage. The framework listing is the thing to celebrate.
regions.question: Who owns the French documentation deadline?

regions.name: Iberia
highlights: Online channel doubled year on year off a small base.
First Portuguese distributor agreement signed in May.
Two agricultural pilots converted to production deployments.
regions.risk: Smallest region and the thinnest coverage: one departure would put 20 per cent of revenue at risk.
regions.notes: Momentum is real but the base is small. Do not over-read the percentages.
regions.question: Is it time to add a second field engineer in Iberia?
